about: one Undertaker per Royal Rumble (rumble_one_each, 2026-10-27): the player is the game's Undertaker (0x003); the field drawn from the Superstars brought over only (qa_rr_ports: Undertaker 1999, 0x00A, among them), 20 of them -- without the rule he'd come; with it, never

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the game's Undertaker is in it
expect.check: 0x0003 in (s0_id, s1_id, s2_id, s3_id, s4_id, s5_id)

expect.name: Undertaker 1999 never comes
expect.check: 0x000A not in (s0_id, s1_id, s2_id, s3_id, s4_id, s5_id)
